issue_context.title: Brief/long description documentation comments aren't working properly
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha.custom_build [5fec0d232]

### System information

Arch on 5.18.10-arch1-1

### Issue description

```gdscript
extends Node

## Says Hello1.
##
## Method description here.
func hello1() -> void:
	print("Hello1")

## Says Hello2.
##
## Method description here.
func hello2() -> void:
	print("Hello2")

```

### Steps to reproduce

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14253836/179213106-ab6f4a28-1207-4bb8-a44d-e8c8b7cb9481.png)


### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: This likely happens because the GDScript documentation system wasn't designed for cases where you have method descriptions but no class description.

Hello there 👋 

I have done a quick spike on this issue and came up with [this](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/63123). It's not pretty, but this is just POC and there might be a better way to fix the issue. I would be happy to apply any feedback to improve it 🙏 

I don't have much experience with the codebase or C++, so please excuse my clumsy solutions in advance 😄 

Cheers

review_comments:
After `p_brief` and `p_desc` and `p_tutorials` are populated, `line` points to the next line (after the comment block). 

I compare it with the line of the first member of the class and if it's the same line - then discard the values populated because they belong to the member.
